description: This file implements the 'NeedData' class, which handles media data requests in a GStreamer-based media player context. It manages signaling for audio and video data needs based on the current stream info and interacts with a client interface to notify about media data requirements.

classes.name: NeedData
classes.description: Handles signaling when media data is needed for audio or video streams within the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: NeedData::NeedData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NeedData object with context, client, and source.

methods.name: NeedData::~NeedData
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of NeedData handling.

methods.name: NeedData::execute
methods.description: Executes the logic to determine if media data is needed for audio or video streams and notifies the client accordingly.
